label: C2701_V7_FIXED_FOLLOWUP

evaluation.support: identical known outcomes and stable BTS identities between models
diagnostics: paired date-block sensitivity with 1/7/14 day blocks
evaluation.selection: All original and candidate outcomes reported; no changes to C, predictors, calibrators or approved model based on this evaluation.

information_experiment.source: Archived NWS terminal aerodrome forecast issue time as preserved by Iowa Environmental Mesonet
information_experiment.comparison: same stable BTS schedule proxies and eligible flights, static model versus static plus origin TAF
information_experiment.scheduled_time: BTS FlightDate and CRSDepTime localized to origin; 2400 and ambiguous or nonexistent clock values excluded from the TAF comparison
information_experiment.features: Origin prevailing forecast visibility, ceiling, winds and weather indicators including missingness; exact feature definitions fixed from archive schema before matching outcomes
information_experiment.evaluation_role: predeparture proxy experiment, neither observed future weather nor actual booking-time schedules

groups: forecast-defined adverse windows given by prevailing visibility under 3 SM or ceiling under 1000 ft, thunderstorm or freezing rain
fixed US federal holiday travel dates (holiday plus and minus one day), a calendar proxy for demand rather than realized passenger volume

chronology: No 2026-01 through 2026-08 flight data have been examined during the v7 validation design. These months precede already scored 2026-09; a new period later than September requires an available official BTS release.
publication: Historical-reference and archived forecast information-time comparison; live 2027 forecasting requires actual schedule snapshots and availability evidence.
